title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution of the Kyrgyz Republic
organization: State Committee for Ecology and Climate of the Kyrgyz Republic
temporal_coverage: Updated NDC published in 2021, with commitments and measures through 2030.
methodology: Prepared through an inter-agency process with experts, scientists, civil society, the private sector, and youth.
limitations: National policy assessment; proposed adaptation measures are not evaluated outcomes.

title: Kyrgyz Republic Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: World Bank CCDR summary page presenting current risks and projections through mid-century.
methodology: Official World Bank summary of the 2025 CCDR risk, economic-impact, and policy findings.
limitations: The complete report PDF exceeded the browser size limit; the official summary does not specify all model scenarios.

title: World Bank Supports the Kyrgyz Republic in Sustainable Landscape Management and Climate Mitigation and Adaptation
temporal_coverage: Press release dated February 2024; project implementation planned through 2029.
methodology: Official World Bank release describing an approved resilient-landscape project and intended coverage and activities.
limitations: Beneficiary figures and activities are project plans, not completed results.

title: What is the Impact of Climate on Local Communities in the Isfara River Catchment?
organization: Mountain Societies Research Institute, University of Central Asia
temporal_coverage: Field research February-November 2019; runoff and climate series include historical and 1999-2018 observations
methodology: Combines hydrology, satellite vegetation and six-village interviews.
limitations: Perceptions differ from runoff; data gaps remain.

title: The impact of climate change on the dynamics of conflicts in the transboundary river basins of Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan
temporal_coverage: Field and analytical process September-November 2021; publication copyright 2021 and portal dated January 2022
methodology: Desk review plus interviews and focus groups in three-country border areas.
limitations: Regional qualitative analysis; some evidence is expert-reported.

title: Every drop counts: FAO support for the implementation of an electronic irrigation water monitoring system in Kyrgyzstan
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
geographic_coverage: pilot areas in Naryn and Batken
temporal_coverage: Project and local water-management examples reported in 2024
methodology: FAO feature story describes project implementation and farmer/community experiences.
limitations: Agency feature story; reported conflict reduction and local benefits are not accompanied by an independent impact evaluation.

title: Consultations to analyse vulnerabilities to climate change impacts and identify adaptation priorities with representatives of Osh, Jalal-Abad and Batken provinces
temporal_coverage: Provincial adaptation consultations held in February 2023; release published February 2024
methodology: UNDP account of consultations with provincial government and sector representatives as part of a climate risk and vulnerability assessment.
limitations: Press release records participant views and planning status, not a completed vulnerability assessment or adaptation outcomes.
